title: Making Spirits Bright: DoorDash Reveals Its Top 50 Local Liquor Stores for the Holidays
summary: Discover the local shops helping consumers toast to the holiday season
body_markdown:
The holiday season brings plenty of reasons to gather, reconnect, and raise a glass. It’s also the perfect time to celebrate the neighborhood shops that help people make those moments special. Today, DoorDash is unveiling its first-ever list of **Top 50 Local Liquor Stores for the Holidays*** , recognizing standout small and medium-sized liquor stores across the United States.


With a busy holiday calendar, these local businesses make it easier to find something for every plan: a hostess gift for tonight’s party, craft beer for a Thanksgiving Eve reunion, wine for the next day’s dinner, or a non-alcoholic option for the holiday toast.


> “We’re excited to introduce our inaugural Top 50 Local Liquor Stores for the Holidays list and spotlight the neighborhood staples that deliver convenience, joy, and a personal touch to the season,” said Jacob Morello, General Manager of Alcohol & Regulated Goods at DoorDash. “These are the local businesses people count on for their celebrations, and we’re proud to help more customers discover and shop their selections on DoorDash, no matter the occasion.”


**Trends On Tap**
Local liquor stores play a big role in what arrives at consumers’ doors: between January and September 2026, **more than 65% of alcohol delivery orders through DoorDash in the U.S. came from small businesses** . ****** And what were consumers ordering? **Lager, ready-to-drink cocktails and drinks, vodka, white wine, and whiskey** topped the list of alcohol categories ordered on DoorDash in the U.S. during that same period.


**Meet the Top 50** Based on DoorDash data from October 2025 through October 2026, the list includes small and medium-sized liquor stores with fewer than 10 stores, at least 100 reviews, and the highest average consumer ratings during the measurement period.


Think local Central Coast sips from[Riviera Market](https://www.doordash.com/store/33250289) , or a party-ready bottle of champagne from[Long's Wine & Liquor Depot](https://www.doordash.com/store/24395177) in Brooklyn, NY. Whether you’re revisiting a familiar shop or discovering a new one, these merchants deserve a place in your holiday plans.

**The list of Top 50 Local Liquor Stores for the Holidays was generated by analyzing DoorDash data from October 2025 to October 2026.
